schema.description: One execution attempt of a logical ingestion run, including its outcome and health observations.
schema.name: source_run_attempts

properties.description: Domain-qualified source identifier shared with the catalogue and archive
properties.name: source_id

properties.description: Stable source-local synchronization stream
properties.name: scope

properties.description: Live or configured backfill cursor namespace within the stream
properties.name: cursor_namespace

properties.description: Stable logical run identifier reused by its retries
properties.name: run_id

properties.description: One-based execution attempt within the logical run
properties.name: attempt

properties.description: Whether the input comes from a source or retained archive captures
properties.name: mode

properties.description: UTC instant at which the attempt was registered
properties.name: started_at

properties.description: UTC instant the outcome was recorded; null for an unfinished attempt
properties.name: finished_at

properties.description: Terminal run outcome; null until recorded
properties.name: status

properties.description: SHA-256 of the crawler configuration used by this attempt
properties.name: config_sha256

properties.description: SHA-256 of the code used by this attempt
properties.name: code_sha256

properties.description: Reviewed reason identifier for accepting incomplete or invalid input as success
properties.name: incomplete_reason

properties.description: Native records read by the attempt; null if unmeasured
properties.name: record_count

properties.description: Claims committed by the attempt; null if unmeasured
properties.name: claim_count

properties.description: Records rejected by the attempt; null if unmeasured
properties.name: reject_count

properties.description: Records quarantined by the attempt; null if unmeasured
properties.name: quarantine_count

properties.description: Response entity bytes received by the attempt; null if unmeasured
properties.name: bytes_received

properties.description: Source requests counted against the attempt budget; null if unmeasured
properties.name: requests_used

properties.description: Request limit applied to this attempt; null if inapplicable
properties.name: request_budget

properties.description: Cursor lag in whole seconds when this attempt finished; null if unknown or inapplicable
properties.name: cursor_lag_seconds

schema.description: Ordered standard source error and disposition history for each attempt.
schema.name: source_run_errors

properties.description: Domain-qualified source identifier shared with the catalogue and archive
properties.name: source_id

properties.description: Stable source-local synchronization stream
properties.name: scope

properties.description: Live or configured backfill cursor namespace within the stream
properties.name: cursor_namespace

properties.description: Stable logical run identifier reused by its retries
properties.name: run_id

properties.description: One-based execution attempt within the logical run
properties.name: attempt

properties.description: One-based occurrence number within the attempt
properties.name: error_no

properties.description: UTC instant at which the source condition was observed
properties.name: observed_at

properties.description: Standard source condition code; retry class follows the crawler vocabulary
properties.name: error_code

schema.description: A batch applied in the loader transaction and its committed raw archive manifest reference.
schema.name: source_loaded_batches

properties.description: Domain-qualified source identifier shared with the catalogue and archive
properties.name: source_id

properties.description: Stable source-local synchronization stream
properties.name: scope

properties.description: Live or configured backfill cursor namespace within the stream
properties.name: cursor_namespace

properties.description: Stable logical run identifier reused by its retries
properties.name: run_id

properties.description: Logical batch identifier within the run, stable across attempts
properties.name: batch_id

properties.description: Attempt that committed the batch
properties.name: attempt

properties.description: Run component of the retained raw archive BatchKey
properties.name: archive_run_id

properties.description: Batch component of the retained raw archive BatchKey
properties.name: archive_batch_id

properties.description: UTC instant recorded by the loader when applying the batch
properties.name: loaded_at

schema.description: Append-only checkpoint advances, each linked to a loaded batch in the same stream.
schema.name: source_checkpoints

properties.description: Domain-qualified source identifier shared with the catalogue and archive
properties.name: source_id

properties.description: Stable source-local synchronization stream
properties.name: scope

properties.description: Live or configured backfill cursor namespace within the stream
properties.name: cursor_namespace

properties.description: One-based checkpoint generation; the greatest committed revision is current
properties.name: revision

properties.description: Logical run of the batch justifying the advance
properties.name: run_id

properties.description: Logical batch justifying the advance
properties.name: batch_id

properties.description: Crawler cursor strategy used for this stream
properties.name: cursor_strategy

properties.description: Snapshot SHA-256 or opaque stable source position for id_range
properties.name: cursor_token

properties.description: UTC resume watermark for updated_since or exclusive end of a processed window
properties.name: watermark_at

properties.description: UTC instant recorded by the loader when applying this advance
properties.name: advanced_at
